objective: Prospectively test whether a question-only evidence-cardinality model trained on already exposed non-IIRC histories transfers to an untouched IIRC train partition and improves source-level evidence F1 over frozen fixed-cardinality retrieval controls.

independence_boundary.iirc_train_before_protocol_freeze: Only file hashes, counts, and question IDs were read; no question, answer, answer type, gold context, gold-cardinality aggregate, or target metric was inspected.

model_development.features: Question-text lexical and hashed features only.

adapter.candidate_unit: One source-level representative chunk for the main article and each unique resolvable original IIRC article link.
adapter.linked_title_normalization: URL-decode, replace underscores with spaces, collapse whitespace, lowercase.
adapter.main_source_identity: sha256(main|pid) truncated to 16 hex characters with s prefix.
adapter.linked_source_identity: sha256(link|normalized_title) truncated to 16 hex characters with s prefix.

chunking.representative_chunk: Highest question-BM25 chunk per source, tie-broken by paragraph and chunk order, chosen without gold.

adapter.gold_unit: Unique IIRC context passage sources; main maps to the main source and linked passages map through original article links.
adapter.unresolved_gold_or_out_of_original_links: Fail closed rather than substitute or drop a case.

candidate.name: cross_dataset_question_cardinality_frc_v86
candidate.cardinality: Frozen ordinal question-text model selects one through four sources.
candidate.ordering: Greedy FRC source order using source-maximum cross-encoder score plus 0.15 times mean positive role-coverage gain.

development.partition: first 400 IDs after ascending sha256(partition_salt + qid)

confirmation.partition: next 800 IDs after the development partition

decision_rules.development_all_strict_gates_pass: Create a confirmation-open artifact, then prepare, score, select, and evaluate the frozen confirmation partition exactly once.
decision_rules.development_any_strict_gate_fails: Stop v86 without preparing or accessing confirmation content; do not alter or relax the protocol.
decision_rules.confirmation_all_strict_gates_pass: Record independent-dataset source-selection transfer support only.
decision_rules.confirmation_any_strict_gate_fails: Close v86 without adoption and do not repackage the confirmation set.
decision_rules.any_algorithm_model_adapter_control_metr: Requires v87 and new untouched IDs from the remaining commitment.

artifact_boundary.published_reports: Aggregates and ID-level metrics without source text.
artifact_boundary.license_status: Official project license page was inaccessible during preparation, so source text redistribution is prohibited for this experiment.
